verdict_villa_kbli.rationale: Triangulated from three independent sources on this branch: (1) the canonical KBLI 2025 catalog (apps/.../kbli_2025_catalogo_completo.txt, extracted from Peraturan BPS 7/2025) contains '55203 — AKTIVITAS VILA' and does NOT contain 55193 at all; (2) research/company/2026-05-31-kbli-2025-accommodation-crosswalk-nlm-source.md states 55203=AKTIVITAS VILA is the current KBLI 2025 villa code and 55193 is a legacy/stale KBLI-2020 reference; (3) apps/backend-rag/backend/services/whatsapp_kbli_guard.py codifies 55203 as the current code and 55193 as the KBLI-2020/PP28 source code that maps to 55203. The NB-3 oracle answer of 55193 (per S2 audit) is STALE: it reflects the pre-KBLI-2025 classification. Caveat: final classification still depends on operating model — 55203 for direct villa operation, 55901 for third-party management, 55400 for booking/intermediation. (Note: the S6 nominee/positive-list research files mention 55194 for Vila, itself a legacy code not in the 2025 catalog; 55203 supersedes it under BPS 7/2025.)
verdict_villa_kbli.resolves: S2 DOUBT_gate_unavailable — the divergence is now resolved on documentary ground-truth (no DeepSeek gate needed; three committed sources agree). The codebase value (55203) is correct; the oracle value (55193) is stale.
